name: rka
description: Research Knowledge Agent (RKA) — Claude Code plugin distribution from the local clone of the RKA repository. Add this marketplace via /plugin marketplace add <path-to-cloned-rka-repo>, then install the plugin via /plugin install rka@rka.

plugins.name: rka
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to a local RKA backend for provenance-tracked research workflows. Provides typed MCP dispatch, three research roles (Brain, Executor, and PI), five Core slash commands, and a SessionStart backend check. Manuscript drafting is provided separately by the explicit-only rka-writer plugin.
